title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Earnestly Studying, Publicizing, and Implementing the General Principles of Civil Law
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on the Earnest Study, Publicity, and Implementation of the General Principles of the Civil Law

Fa (Min) Fa [1986] No. 17

To all local people's courts at various levels, all military courts, railway transport courts, and maritime courts:

The General Principles of the Civil Law of the People's Republic of China, adopted at the Fourth Session of the Sixth National People's Congress, shall come into effect on January 1, 1987. The promulgation and implementation of the General Principles of the Civil Law will play an important role in protecting the lawful rights and interests of citizens and legal persons, promoting the reform of the economic system, and ensuring the development of socialist modernization. The General Principles of the Civil Law constitute the common norms and legal basis that people's courts must follow when adjudicating civil cases and economic disputes. Therefore, the earnest study, publicity, and implementation of the General Principles of the Civil Law are an important task for the people's courts. To effectively carry out this work, the following notice is hereby given:

1. People's courts at all levels shall organize judicial personnel, especially civil and economic trial judges and judges of people's tribunals, to earnestly study the General Principles of the Civil Law. Emphasis shall be placed on understanding the legislative intent, accurately grasping the legal provisions, and, in light of the new situations, new problems, and new experiences arising from the economic system reform and civil and economic trial work, grasp the key points and study thoroughly and deeply. Courts with the capacity may hold short-term training courses to train cadres in batches, or use meetings for training purposes. The content of the General Principles of the Civil Law covers a wide range and is relatively complex. Personnel from teaching and research departments, as well as from departments engaged in economics, trade, industry and commerce administration, customs, taxation, finance, insurance, patents, publishing, etc., may be invited to give lectures and introduce relevant professional knowledge so as to deepen the study.

2. In conjunction with the popularization of legal knowledge and comprehensive governance, actively coordinate with relevant departments, make unified arrangements, and carry out extensive and in-depth publicity activities for the General Principles of the Civil Law. Educate the broad masses of the people to correctly exercise their civil rights, consciously fulfill their civil obligations, and resolve civil and economic disputes in accordance with the law. People's courts shall, through the trial of cases, use typical cases to study the law and explain the law by reference to the cases. At the same time, seize upon some typical cases of educational significance, conduct public trials in accordance with the law, and expand the effect of case handling, so that the General Principles of the Civil Law become familiar, mastered, and followed by the broad masses of the people. Publicity shall pay attention to accuracy and social effect.

3. To ensure the correct implementation of the General Principles of the Civil Law, people's courts at all levels must vigorously strengthen investigation and research work. The current focus of investigation and research shall be on the new situations and new problems in the production and circulation of commodities regulated by the General Principles of the Civil Law in the course of economic system reform, as well as issues concerning civil subjects, protection of civil rights, formation and performance of obligations, assumption of civil liability, statute of limitations, and the application of law in civil relations involving foreign elements. To resolve certain specific issues in the application of the General Principles of the Civil Law, the Supreme People's Court, in accordance with the provisions and legislative intent of the General Principles of the Civil Law and on the basis of investigation, research, and summary of trial practice experience, intends to propose Opinions on Several Issues Concerning the Implementation of the General Principles of the Civil Law, and plans to convene a conference on the implementation of the General Principles of the Civil Law at an appropriate time. To this end, all people's courts are requested to actively submit relevant work experience and typical case materials, as well as questions and suggestions, to our court for study and reference.

4. All people's courts must adhere to the principle of ensuring that laws are observed and strictly enforced. After the official implementation of the General Principles of the Civil Law, all opinions and replies issued by the Supreme People's Court over the years concerning the implementation of civil and economic laws and policies that are inconsistent with the General Principles of the Civil Law shall cease to be effective. In the process of implementing the General Principles of the Civil Law, continuous experience shall be summarized. Important issues concerning the application of law in implementation shall be promptly reported. Higher-level courts shall strengthen supervision and guidance. People's courts at all levels shall strive to do a good job and promote the comprehensive development of civil and economic trial work.

This notice is hereby given.

May 16, 1986
